name: Fund Settlement Parameters 24
definition: Parameters applied to the settlement of a security.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository or an International Central Securities Depository.

TradeTransactionCondition.name: Trade Transaction Condition
TradeTransactionCondition.definition: Condition under which the order/trade is to be/was executed. This may be required for settlement through T2S.

SettlementTransactionCondition.name: Settlement Transaction Condition
SettlementTransactionCondition.definition: Condition under which the order/trade is to be settled. This may be required for settlement through T2S.

SecuritiesSettlementSystemIdentification.name: Securities Settlement System Identification
SecuritiesSettlementSystemIdentification.definition: Identification of a specific system or set of rules and/or processes to be applied at the settlement place.
